title: Claude Haiku And GPT-6 Luna Cost 10¢. Until 100K Tokens.
description:
Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna both list $0.10 in / $0.50 out per 1M tokens, cache reads $0.01. Past 100K prompt tokens Haiku jumps to $0.50 / $2.50; Luna stays $0.10 / $0.50 up to 272K, then $0.20 / $0.75.
